They finished 45th in [[DecipherCon 1999 Progressive Sealed Deck]] at [[DecipherCon 1999]]<ref name="dc99sw22_2">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW22_2.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: Progressive Sealed Deck], Decipher.
